brief.brief: a Scandinavian timber house: steep gable roof with deep eaves, vertical board cladding, white window frames with mullions, a front door under a small canopy, a brick chimney and a low stone plinth; 9 m wide, 3 floors, sage cladding (#8FA58A), oxblood door (#5E1F1E), dark grey standing-seam metal roof, no balcony
